about: Two pieces in one batch. Under 2026-09-20: the Mara line, the untagged post line, and a comment asking for the post line in idea-mara. Under 2026-09-21: the Tobias line with a comment under it naming idea-tobias. u1 (Mara) and u2 (Tobias) are both approved on round 0, and the findings list the post line as missed. The Edit guard gives [] and the run closes with no second check. The missed post line stays off, and so does the 2026-09-20 comment, because its piece holds a missed line; the other piece's comment isn't held back. The log opens with 'Nothing needs you.', holds Migrated, then Lines the checker says were missed (the post line quoted, the migration-verifier's words, 'The next migration run tries this again.').
